reviews.conclusion: Overworld eye triangulation contains two brief settings samples and two compressed game views lasting 3.0-3.5 s and 1.5-2.0 s. Their pause state cannot be established from the obscured HUD. These are ordinary context but do not exactly resolve the -5.7667 s deficit.
Fortress traversal/combat contains two video/options visits totaling 1.0-2.0 s, compatible with -1.3 s. Play resumes continuously in the sampled proxy.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
